# prime-galleria

prime-rs: Galleria component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/galleria) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-galleria) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/galleria.md)

Galleria: a port of `p-galleria` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Image gallery: a large frame, scrollable thumbnails, indicators, captions, automatic frame advance
and fullscreen mode (a mask in `body`). The thumbnail window is computed by the pure `model`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_galleria::{Galleria, GalleriaImage};

let images = vec![GalleriaImage::new("a.jpg").thumbnail("a-small.jpg").alt("A")];
let html = view! { <Galleria value=images /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-galleria-item") && html.contains("a.jpg"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-galleria = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["galleria"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
